correctness.rationale: Using (2/pi)∫disk |z|^{2m}(1-|z|²)dA=2/[(m+1)(m+2)], the energy equals Σ_{n>=1} 2|Σ_j exp(inθj)|²/[n(n+1)]. Expanding pairs gives 2N+2Σ_{j<k} φ(θj−θk), φ=2Σ cos(nθ)/[n(n+1)]; away from collisions φ(θ)=∫_0^1 (1−t²)/(1−2t cosθ+t²)dt>0, justified by the Abel/closed-log representation. The full-angle Hessian is twice the weighted cycle Laplacian; exact Nth-root Poisson sums give λ_s=2N∫_0^1 [(1−t^s)(1−t^{N−s})/(1−t^N)]dt. Integrating the grouped convergent series gives stated digamma formula; positivity, Fourier modes, monotone mode extrema follow by strict convexity of t^s+t^{N−s}. Taylor in the rotation-orthogonal subspace proves sharp λ_1/2, attained asymptotically along a first real Fourier mode. Digamma expansion gives N−4ζ(3)/N²+12ζ(4)/N³ and dominated convergence gives max 2N−8 log2+o(1); ratio→2. Independently compared 2N integral against the digamma formula at 120 (s,N) instances for N=2,3,4,7,20,90 at 40-digit precision, agreement to <1e−27; the N=2 check gives 8log2−4. The integral proof, not finite quadrature, establishes arbitrary N.
residual_risks: Only the 1−|z|² weight and angle metric in radians; fixed-N local o(norm²) is not uniform in N.
